messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: Sudden spike in KV-store paging and cont-batch queue timeouts in us-east-1. Creating incident thread. Service: inference-runtime
Neha: I'm seeing customer 5xx and generation stalls. cont-batch assembly latencies spiking, lots of tiny batches and also some very large batches causing over-fetching.
Evan: traces show frequent KV page faults for long prefixes: "page_faults=1200/min, io_wait=2.1s". KV cache size trending down despite available memory.
Riya: ops dashboard shows cont-batch.max_num_seqs jumped to 128 in config change 20m ago. That seems high.
Marcus: who pushed that change? Searching audit logs.
Riya: found PR https://git.internal/redwood/configs/changes/1234 by perf-team (intention: improve throughput on long-context models).
Neha: that explains it. Large max_num_seqs -> very tall batches -> big working set -> KV cache eviction + excessive paging -> IO stalls -> timeouts.
incident-bot: Severity escalated to Sev2 due to customer-impacting 5xxs. Paging pressure causing elevated tail latency.
Evan: mitigation options: immediately cap max_num_seqs, reduce max_batch_tokens, increase batch_timeout to allow better batching behavior, or enable kv-protect (soft cap on evictions).
Neha: propose fast rollback of max_num_seqs to 32, set max_batch_tokens to 3072, batch_timeout_ms to 100, and enable kv-protect. Do canary first in us-east-1-a.
Marcus: I can push the canary config. Preparing payload.
Marcus: ```
POST /api/v1/config/apply
{
  "region":"us-east-1",
  "cont_batch":{
    "max_num_seqs":32,
    "max_batch_tokens":3072,
    "batch_timeout_ms":100
  },
  "kv_tuning":{
    "kv_protect":true
  }
}
```
deploy-bot: rollout started: config/cont-batch -> us-east-1-a (5%) at 2026-03-15T10:03:12Z.
Riya: monitoring kv_page_in/sec, evict/sec, cont-batch assemble latency, and 5xx count.
(incident-bot) 10:04:30Z: Canary shows immediate improvement: assemble_p95 down 2.2s -> 320ms on canary hosts; kv_page_in/sec reduced by 78% on canary.
Neha: push to 25% and watch for a minute.
Marcus: bumped to 25%.
deploy-bot: rollout progressed 25% at 10:05:00Z.
Evan: region-wide p95 improved from 4.2s -> 900ms after 25%.
Riya: no failed hosts; metrics look good. Rolling to 60%.
deploy-bot: progressed to 60% at 10:05:55Z.
Neha: customer 3rd-party telemetry (C-ops) reporting request success rates recovering. Notify CS.
cs-bot: Notifying Customer Success: ticket C-20045 linked. Summary queued.
Marcus: rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: rollout complete 100% at 10:07:10Z. no rollbacks.
Evan: post-hotfix numbers: kv_page_faults down to 120/min (from 1200), io_wait 200ms, 5xx rate down 87%.
Neha: mitigation effective. Key notes: the perf PR increased max_num_seqs without cross-checking memory/kv footprint for mixed workloads.
Marcus: I'm opening an immediate guardrail PR to reject max_num_seqs > 64 for prod and to require a mem-footprint estimate for changes that touch cont-batch.
Marcus: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/configs/pull/790
Riya: adding alert: kv_page_faults > 500/min or evict_rate > 300/s -> pager to SRE. Also add cont-batch assemble p95 > 1s alert.
Neha: action items: 1) RCA ticket INC-407654-rca, owners: Riya (config drift), Evan (Kv telemetry), Marcus (guardrails), Neha (postmortem). 2) Add synthetic test in CI to exercise mixed short/prefix-heavy traffic. 3) Update runbook with rollback commands.
Marcus: rollback snippet for reference:
```
# rollback cont-batch
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/apply -d '{"region":"us-east-1","cont_batch":{"max_num_seqs":32,"max_batch_tokens":3072,"batch_timeout_ms":100}}'
# optionally toggle kv_protect off/on
```
Neha: handing off to night on-call Evan in 20m. Evan, check kv page-in metrics and customer ticket list in C-ops after handoff.
Evan: acknowledged. I'll keep an elevated watch for 6 hours and collect kernel-level pagefault traces to correlate with PR change window.
incident-bot: Handoff: Neha -> Evan. Channel remains open for RCA updates. :handshake:
Riya: retro note: perf-team intended to reduce CPU overhead by packing more sequences per batch, but didn't test for workloads where KV hot prefixes dominate. We'll require a short checklist for future perf PRs: memory modeling, kv-impact, staging test with prefix storms.
Neha: thanks all. Filing postmortem draft and will include timeline, metric graphs, and recommended config guardrails.
cs-bot: Customer Success notified affected accounts. They'll reach out with incident summary within 90 minutes.
Marcus: closing mitigation. Leaving monitoring alerts on for 12h with reduced thresholds.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> downgraded to Sev3. Keep ticket INC-407654-rca open for RCA completion. :white_check_mark:"
